name: Tavily
summary: Tavily is a web access API for AI agents with endpoints for search, extract, crawl, map and an in-depth research agent. It is billed in credits with a free monthly allowance. Tavily announced in February 2026 that it is joining Nebius.
goodFor: Credit-based pricing with a free tier
watchOut: Research endpoint cost varies widely per request (4–250 credits)
Ownership change to Nebius may shift roadmap
